description: Create a complete document scanner page (scanner.html) with CamScanner-like functionality: camera capture, multi-page support, image enhancement (contrast/sharpening/document mode), PDF generation, and auto-upload to customer record. Also add supporting API endpoint in server.js.
steps: Create /public/scanner.html - a standalone mobile-first page with its own URL (/scanner.html). This page should include: (a) Customer search bar at top that searches existing customers via GET /api/customers?q=... and lets user select which customer to upload docs for. (b) Document type selector - choose between 'Agreement' or 'Receipt' upload. (c) Camera capture UI - a button to open the device camera (using navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with {video: {facingMode: 'environment'}}). Show live camera preview. Capture button to take photo. (d) Multi-page support - after capturing one photo, show it as a thumbnail and offer 'Add More Pages' button to capture additional pages. Show page count. (e) Image enhancement controls per captured page: brightness/contrast slider, auto-enhance button (applies document-scan-like processing: grayscale conversion, high contrast, threshold for B&W, sharpening via canvas convolution), rotate 90 degrees button, crop/retake option. (f) Preview all pages in a scrollable thumbnail strip. Allow reordering (drag or up/down buttons) and deleting individual pages. (g) 'Create PDF & Upload' button that: uses jsPDF (loaded from CDN https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.2/jspdf.umd.min.js) to combine all enhanced images into a single PDF, then auto-uploads to the selected customer using the existing upload endpoints (POST /api/customers/:id/upload-agreement or POST /api/customers/:id/upload-receipt depending on doc type selection). (h) Success/error feedback with link back to customer detail in main CRM.

Style the scanner page mobile-first: full viewport camera preview, large touch-friendly buttons, bottom toolbar for capture controls, dark background during camera mode for better visibility. Use the same CSS custom properties (--purple, --navy, etc.) from index.html for brand consistency. Add a top nav bar with 'Ruralift Doc Scanner' title and a link back to main CRM (/).

Add image processing functions in scanner.html using Canvas API: (a) autoEnhance() - converts to grayscale, applies contrast stretch, optional adaptive threshold for pure B&W document look. (b) adjustBrightness(value) - slider-based brightness/contrast. (c) sharpen() - 3x3 convolution kernel for sharpening. (d) rotateImage(degrees) - rotate canvas 90/180/270. All operations work on the canvas and update the preview in real-time.

Implement the PDF generation: use jsPDF to create A4 pages, fit each captured/enhanced image to the page maintaining aspect ratio, compress images as JPEG at 0.85 quality before adding to PDF to keep file size reasonable.

Add a new API endpoint in server.js: POST /api/customers/:id/upload-scanned/:docType (where docType is 'agreement' or 'receipt'). This reuses the existing parseMultipart function and saves the file the same way as upload-agreement/upload-receipt endpoints (as agreement-{id}.pdf or receipt-{id}.pdf in /uploads/). Update customer state with agreementPdf or receiptPdf field accordingly. This keeps backward compatibility with existing upload display in index.html.

Add a navigation link to the scanner page in the sidebar of index.html - add a 'Doc Scanner' nav item with a camera icon SVG that links to /scanner.html (using window.location.href since it is a separate page).
acceptance_criteria: Opening /scanner.html in a browser loads the document scanner page without errors
Customer search on scanner page returns results from the API and allows selection
Camera opens on mobile devices using rear-facing camera by default
Multiple photos can be captured in sequence and shown as thumbnails
Auto-enhance applies visible contrast/document-quality improvement to captured images
Brightness/contrast slider adjusts image in real-time on the canvas
Rotate button rotates the image 90 degrees
Pages can be reordered and deleted before creating PDF
Clicking 'Create PDF & Upload' generates a valid PDF and uploads it to the selected customer
After successful upload, the customer's detail view in index.html shows the PDF badge
The POST /api/customers/:id/upload-scanned/:docType endpoint works and saves the file correctly
The scanner page is usable on mobile (large buttons, proper viewport, touch-friendly)
A 'Doc Scanner' link appears in the sidebar of index.html
verification: Run 'npm install' and 'node server.js &' then use curl to verify GET /scanner.html returns HTML content
Use curl to verify POST /api/customers/1781242858352/upload-scanned/agreement accepts multipart upload and saves file
Verify the scanner.html file contains jsPDF CDN script tag
Verify scanner.html contains getUserMedia call for camera access
Verify scanner.html contains canvas-based image processing functions (autoEnhance, sharpen, adjustBrightness, rotateImage)
Verify index.html sidebar contains a link to scanner.html
findings: Network environment blocks access to registry.npmjs.org (proxy returns 403). npm install cannot complete in this environment. However, all code passes Node.js syntax checking (node --check server.js) and content verification confirms all required features are present. The server.js endpoint follows the exact same pattern as existing upload-agreement and upload-receipt endpoints. The scanner.html is a self-contained static file that will work when served by Express.
